findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a Codex review emits more than 4,000 characters of stdout before a capacity failure and has empty stderr.
The log scan still cannot see the capacity event. `src/forge/review.py:975–979` starts the pinned helper without enabling streaming, so the helper buffers Codex output. On failure, it uses stdout when stderr is empty and truncates the detail to 4,000 characters ([failure handling](https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills/blob/ce14dcca09b3affb922ddcca11465619e67f5114/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview#L5583-L5590), [truncation](https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills/blob/ce14dcca09b3affb922ddcca11465619e67f5114/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview#L7826-L7830)). The capacity event therefore never reaches the log, and close starts an ordinary attempt without the capacity wait or message. The new test at `tests/test_codex_capacity_recovery.py:94–99` instead makes the fake helper print the complete event before its truncated trailer, so it passes despite this failure.
